James Rodriguez Retires from Colombian National Football Team

Colombian midfielder James Rodriguez announced his retirement from international football on Tuesday. Rodriguez, who earned 131 caps for Colombia, was a key player in the team's run to the 2014 World Cup quarter-finals. He expressed gratitude for his time representing his country, thanking fans for their support through various emotions during his career.
